## CORE · AI gateway
**Purpose**: the only place that calls AI providers (architecture 8.1): route -> model/params/prompt/schema, budget check BEFORE the call (blocked calls never reach the provider, AD-4), request building (prompt caching, structured outputs, PDF/image blocks), response validation, usage and cost for every call (GN-8, tracing).
**Input**: {route, account_type, brand_id?, material_id?, package_id?, variant_id?, job_id?, vars?, schema_name?, attachments?: [{kind, s3_key, mime}], input? (embedding), prompt?/aspect_ratio? (image)}.
**Output**: {result, cost_usd}. Errors: budget_exceeded:… / provider_unavailable:… / fatal:… (the job runner maps them).
**Providers**: Anthropic Messages API (text, vision, PDF), OpenRouter (speech-to-text, images, embeddings).
